package.config.github-enterprise.uri.description:
URI de la instancia de GHE.com o GitHub Enterprise Server.

Ejemplos:
* GHE.com: 'https://octocat.ghe.com`
* GitHub Enterprise Server: 'https://github.octocat.com`

> **Nota:** Debe _no_ establecerse en un URI de GitHub.com. Si su cuenta existe en GitHub.com o es un usuario administrado GitHub Enterprise, no necesita ninguna configuración adicional y simplemente puede iniciar sesión en GitHub.
package.config.github-enterprise.uris.descriptio:
The URIs of your GHE.com or GitHub Enterprise Server instances, such as `https://octocat.ghe.com` or `https://github.octocat.com`. Order does not select a default instance. When signing in, choose an instance if more than one is configured.

This setting takes precedence over `#github-enterprise.uri#`. An explicitly configured empty array disables enterprise instances, even if the deprecated setting is set.

GitHub.com accounts do not need this setting and use the GitHub authentication provider.
